property_summary: After calling file with an unrecognized parameter name ('foo'), the reference contract reverts, while the buggy contract does not revert and emits the event; then calling allowance shows no divergence in revert behavior but the reference contract's state before the call differs, leading to an assertion on the event emission that passes on reference and fails on bug.
change_summary: Delete the revert statement, so an unrecognized parameter simply does nothing instead of reverting.
